Professional Summary
Data engineer with experience building scalable data pipelines, real-time streaming applications, and ETL orchestration for analytics and product teams. Experienced in designing Kafka-based ingestion layers, authoring Airflow DAGs for complex workflows, and optimizing SQL and Spark jobs for performance.

Technical Skills
Python3, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, AWS, Kafka, PySpark, Linux, Git

Work Experience

Data Engineer, UrbanPantry (Apr 2024 - Present)
- Developed Kafka-based ingestion pipelines to capture order and inventory events, reducing data lag from ingestion to availability in the analytics layer to under 30 seconds using Kafka and stream processing; tools used included Kafka, SQL.
- Built and maintained Airflow DAGs to orchestrate nightly ETL workflows that load transformed datasets into analytics tables, improving downstream report reliability; primary technologies: Apache Airflow, SQL.
- Implemented data validation and anomaly detection in Python3 for incoming streams and batch loads, enabling automatic alerting and rollback on schema drift; utilized Kafka and SQL for checks.

Data Engineer, Freshworks (Jun 2023 - Mar 2024)
- Rewrote batch ETL jobs into Spark applications to process customer activity logs, cutting job runtime by 40% and reducing AWS compute costs through tuned Apache Spark configurations.
- Designed Airflow workflows to manage Spark job scheduling and dependencies across environments, improving deployment repeatability; key tools: Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, AWS.
- Collaborated on ingestion improvements and partitioning strategies in data lakes to accelerate analytical SQL queries and support product analytics; technologies included AWS and SQL.

Big Data Engineer, Finlytics (Feb 2022 - May 2023)
- Built PySpark pipelines to process large financial transaction datasets, implementing windowed aggregations and joins to power risk models; performance improvements achieved via optimized PySpark transformations and partitioning.
- Implemented Kafka consumers to stream transactional events into processing clusters and downstream storages, ensuring low-latency availability for monitoring dashboards; technologies: Kafka, PySpark.
- Created and maintained Airflow DAGs to coordinate end-to-end data workflows including batch and streaming handoffs, and authored SQL-based data quality checks to validate outputs.

Education
